newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nikko maintains Shanghai Industrial buy.
newsitem.headline: Nikko maintains Shanghai Industrial buy.

text.p: Nikko Research said on Friday that it maintains its "buy" recommendation for Shanghai Industrial Holdings.
Nikko based its recommendation on several factors.

Shanghai Industrial has substantial investments planned for the second half of 1997, Nikko said. The company plans to borrow US$300 to US$350 million in syndicated loans in late June and this, together with strong operating cash flow, will leave the company in a strong net cash position.
Nikko also said that since Shanghai Industrial recently issued a convertible bond, it is unlikely to sell shares.
Nikko said it has set a six-month target price of HK$50 based on the assumption that Shanghai Industrial will make HK$4 billion worth of investments in the second half.
Shanghai Industrial rose HK$2.30 to HK$44.50 on Friday.
